artifact_check.description: Executed by AI agents and checked by a separate AI-agent rerun using the same image and machine. All 162 cells agreed on tool invocations, outcomes, model request counts, schemas and model-returned text. This is not independent scientific reproduction or replication.
artifact_check.label: Artifact checked

framework_caveats.google-adk: LiteLlm path tested, not native Gemini. Error is exposed in structured fields. ReflectAndRetryModelPlugin is available but not enabled by default.
framework_caveats.langchain: create_agent + ChatOpenAI path tested. Errors remain in invalid_tool_calls; final text is empty in core variants.
framework_caveats.llama-index: OpenAI-compatible integration tested. Truncation is repaired. Extra closing brace invokes with defaults. Documented non-dict-JSON intent in upstream pull request 16316 does not establish documented intent for invalid JSON.
framework_caveats.openai-agents_and_crewai: Strict schemas are advertised; the mock deliberately supplies malformed arguments. Real strict-decoding providers may prevent them.
framework_caveats.pydantic-ai: The installed distribution is pydantic-ai-slim, version 2.55.0.
framework_caveats.smolagents: OpenAIServerModel + ToolCallingAgent, single-parameter tools tested. Malformed string reaches the tool parameter. Source suggests broader first-parameter reach; multi-parameter behavior was not tested.
framework_caveats.strands: OpenAIModel streaming path tested. Parse failure logs a default WARNING and substitutes an empty object; this is already reported upstream. The WARNING is emitted under default logging settings, so the substitution is visible in logs.

limits: No real-model frequency or repair behavior measured.
No production effects, user harm, vulnerability, safety ranking or demand established.
Single-parameter synthetic tools only; multi-parameter tools untested.
Python and Chat Completions only; no JavaScript or Responses API generalization.
Pinned versions and tested provider paths only; current releases may differ.
Original prompts, framework prompt templates, stderr and infrastructure are excluded. Cell data is a derived allowlisted export; private originals remain unchanged.

methods.default_semantics: The synthetic list_items tool has one optional status argument; None lists all items, while archived lists archived items.
methods.mock_behavior: The first reply calls a tool with the scenario arguments. Every later reply is Done., regardless of whether an error or tool result was returned. No model repair or user-facing success claim is measured.

no_execution_no_model_error_core.diagnostic: LangChain exposes invalid_tool_calls.error and ADK exposes MALFORMED_FUNCTION_CALL in structured fields; the model receives no second turn on these calls.

source_classification: company-authored source with a derived allowlisted export of the checked raw outputs
